title: Standing work, a test: iron at Ironhollow Fading Signal (beyond the border) into storage at The Experiment
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-16 18:36 UTC (orders.log ENT-017, block ZERO: every other miner gathers what the stations take, iron first, on fields that hold, each with a floor). The stations' list takes 491,400 iron ore; the fleet holds 104,683 (the tool base_plan, 18:25 UTC). Of the iron fields we read this one has the best iron to copper richness, 40 against 22 (census 17:55 UTC; Acubens Shadow Pocket, 40 against 32, gave up 73% iron between 14:05 and 18:26 UTC), and the one regrowth measured: iron 47,201 at 2026-11-15 21:13 UTC (game/planets/n-ironhollow.md), 57,995 at 2026-11-16 17:55 UTC, about 520 an hour (the tool hive, verb refill). Ironhollow is lawless (police 0, threat medium), one jump from The Experiment: the hold goes out empty (rule F13) and the ore comes home to storage. Nothing is sold. `min_left` keeps 30,000 iron in the field. A test: one ship until its first RESULT line is read (rule F8); then as many ships as the regrowth carries, a light footprint beyond the border. 2026-11-16 23:13 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 1 -> 2. 2026-11-16 23:26 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 2 -> 5. 2026-11-16 23:41 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 5 -> 7. 2026-11-17 00:19 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 7 -> 11. 2026-11-17 00:25 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 11 -> 20. 2026-11-17 00:27 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 20 -> 7.
